_comment: The seven trip-wires from examples/rendered/ANNOTATED.md, as assertions.
Each case is a claim the corpus TEMPTS a model into making and a rule that
stops it. `forbidden` is the trip-wire: those patterns must never appear in a
rendered artifact drawn from examples/corpus/. `expected_in` pins what the
committed example actually shipped, and runs in offline mode only — a live
render may word the safe version differently and still be correct.
`documented_in` keeps each assertion tethered to the row in ANNOTATED.md that
explains it. Delete the row, the case fails as untethered.
Patterns are Python regexes, matched case-insensitively.

cases.rule: render `[NUMBER-CEILING]` — numbers carry their source and their ceiling
cases.why: The resume said 80%, Sam said 'about half', and Sam's memory is the only source either number has. Unresolved numbers do not render.

cases.rule: render `[TRUE-VERSION]` — prefer the true version; obey the user's own ceiling
cases.source: examples/corpus/tidewater/batch-window.md — Sam's ceiling: 'Two teams took it. Not the org.'
cases.why: Two teams adopting a pattern is not org-wide adoption, and an interviewer will ask which teams.

cases.rule: render `[OBEY-DECISIONS]` — obey recorded rendering decisions, including rejected readings
cases.source: examples/corpus/tidewater/batch-window.md — the model's reading, refuted: 'I didn't spot a blind spot, I got woken up by it four times.'
cases.why: Recasting a fix-what-hurts-you story as visionary architectural insight is the exact reading the corpus records as wrong.
'Led the team' from someone who has never had a report is checkable and fatal. Sam led the work.

examples/rendered/resume.md: led a rebuild of the on-call rotation

cases.documented_by: Led the team responsible for six services

cases.rule: render `[NUMBER-CEILING]` + `[HONEST-ATTRIBUTION]` — the number is real; the attribution was not
cases.source: examples/corpus/tidewater/oncall-rebuild.md — the alert cleanup did the work; the rotation change was reversed
cases.why: Crediting the page reduction to the rotation redesign claims credit for the part Sam reversed.

cases.rule: render `[DATE-VOCABULARY]` — date the vocabulary; render `[HONEST-ATTRIBUTION]` — honest attribution
cases.source: examples/corpus/bellhaven/reporting-migration.md — anachronisms_corrected; the schema was a contractor's
cases.why: It was a cron job and a second Postgres. 'Data mesh' postdates the work by three years, and 'architected' claims a contractor's schema.

examples/rendered/resume.md: built and owned the nightly export

cases.source: examples/corpus/profile.md — 'I use Kubernetes. I have never run a cluster.'
cases.why: A skills line is the cheapest place to overclaim and the first place a technical screen probes.
